TRANSLATION OF A FRENCH POLICE REPORT DATED 20.12.39.

The American concern of William Hunt & Company was
founded more than two years ago by William P. Hunt,
a resident of Shanghai and his brothers Harry J. Hunt,
Albert H. Hunt and E. Hunt, who are at present in the
United States.

The immediate object of the organization of the
company was the exploitation of the interests of the
China Merchants Steam Navigation Company, controlled by
the Chinese Nationalist Government, to prevent the
Japanese seizing the concern's properties.

It was on November 9, 1937 (just two days before
the occupation of Nantao by the Japanese) that William
Hunt & Co. officially took under its control the
properties of the China Steam Merchants Steam Navigation
Company located on the Kin Lee Yuan wharf, the name of
which was then changed to that of Roosevelt Terminal .

Little by Little, William Hunt & Co. extended its
control to other Chinese concerns desirous of avoiding
contact with the Japanese.

To-day, this company officially controls, in addition
to the interests of the C.M.S.N.Co., the following
enterprises:-

1) Hunt Engineering Corporation, 53 Foochow Road.
2) Hunt Steamship Corporation (ex-China Foreign S.S. Corpor-
ation), 53 Foochow Road.
3) China Foreign Assurance Corporation.
4) China Foreign Trade Corporation, 47 Ningpo Road.
5) Nanyang Bros. Tobacco Co. Inc. 183/5 Avenue Edward VII.
6) Watson's Mineral Water Co. Inc., 613 Avenue Haig.
7) China Corporation.

It has to be noted that in almost all cases, William
Hunt & Co. only act as agents and that the enterprises cited
above still continue to be directed by their true Chinese
owners.

美商威廉·亨特公司（William Hunt & Company）由上海居民威廉·P·亨特（William P. Hunt）及其兄弟哈里·J·亨特（Harry J. Hunt）、阿尔伯特·H·亨特（Albert H. Hunt）和E·亨特（E. Hunt）于两年多前创立，后三位目前身在美国。

组建该公司的直接目的，是经营受中国国民政府控制的轮船招商局（China Merchants Steam Navigation Company）的权益，以防止日本方面扣押该企业的财产。

1937年11月9日（即日军占领南市前两天），威廉·亨特公司正式接管了位于金利源码头的轮船招商局财产，并将其名称改为罗斯福码头（Roosevelt Terminal）。

渐渐地，威廉·亨特公司将其控制范围扩展到其他希望避免与日本人接触的中国企业。

如今，该公司除控制轮船招商局的权益外，还正式控制以下企业：

1) 亨特工程公司（Hunt Engineering Corporation），福州路53号。
2) 亨特轮船公司（Hunt Steamship Corporation，原中国外商轮船公司 China Foreign S.S. Corporation），福州路53号。
3) 中国外商保险公司（China Foreign Assurance Corporation）。
4) 中国外商贸易公司（China Foreign Trade Corporation），宁波路47号。
5) 南洋兄弟烟草股份有限公司（Nanyang Bros. Tobacco Co. Inc.），爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）183/5号。
6) 屈臣氏矿泉水股份有限公司（Watson's Mineral Water Co. Inc.），海格路（Avenue Haig）613号。
7) 中国公司（China Corporation）。

需要注意的是，在几乎所有情况下，威廉·亨特公司仅作为代理人行事，上述企业仍由其真正的中国所有者继续管理。

He had to resign in 1927 following a certain "scandal"

In 1924 a very important Chinese firm, the Union Trading
Company, failed tothe extent of several hundred thousand
dollars. The enterprises of this house were many; import of
tools, American grain, export of nuts, earth-nuts, cotton, etc;
the concern also had interests in the salt-mines in the
North. The administrator of this company, Henan CHI, an
American returned student, had numerous political acquaintances
in North China; personally he was interested in the trafficking
of narcotics. But more than anything else it was in
unfortunate exchange dealings that he squandered the funds
of the Union Trading Company; numerous embezzlements served
to conceal for a lengthy period the financial losses undergone
by Henan CHI.
He was personally indebted to the Chung Yuen Bank, rue
Takou, British Concession in Tientsin, to the extent of
$125,000; as General CHU YU PU, governor of Shantung, had
interests in this Bank, he had Henan CHI arrested and
detained for more than eighteen months. Under promise of
liberation, CHI undertook to transfer to the director of
the Chung Yuen Bank certain shares and recoverable credits
for the amount of this debt. But, when the Chung Yuen
Bank wished to negotiate these securities, it was perceived
that certain transfer formalities which needed the signature
of Henan CHI, had not been carried out. Henan CHI then
countersigned the balance against his liberty and thus
obtained his release. Since his release from prison, he
has disavowed all contracts taken in regard to the Chung
Yuen Bank, which of course injured the other creditors.

1924年，一家重要的中国商行——联合贸易公司（Union Trading Company）破产，亏损达数十万美元。该行经营范围广泛，包括进口工具、美国谷物，出口坚果、花生、棉花等；该企业还在北方的盐矿拥有权益。该公司管理员季赫南（Henan CHI，音译），是一名留美归国学生，在华北地区拥有众多政治人脉；个人而言，他涉足毒品走私。但更重要的是，他在不幸的外汇交易中挥霍了联合贸易公司的资金；多次挪用公款以在很长一段时间内掩盖季赫南造成的财务损失。
他个人欠天津英租界大沽路（rue Takou）中原银行（Chung Yuen Bank）12.5万美元；由于山东省主席朱玉普将军（General CHU YU PU，音译）在该行拥有权益，他下令逮捕季赫南并将其拘押超过十八个月。在获释的承诺下，季赫南承诺将其持有的部分股票及可收回债权转让给中原银行行长，以抵偿债务金额。但是，当中原银行试图处置这些证券时，发现某些需要季赫南签名的转让手续并未办理。随后，季赫南在余额文件上补签以换取自由，从而获得释放。自出狱以来，他否认了所有与中原银行签订的合同，这当然损害了其他债权人的利益。

La "William Hunt & Co." maison américaine, a été

contact avec les japonais.

随后，联合贸易公司的清算依法进行，并任命了一名清算人，即R.E.T. 麦克唐纳（MacDONNEL）。

在此次清算过程中，威廉·亨特（William HUNT）的名字与季赫南联系在一起，前者辞去美国副领事职务可能与威廉·亨特和季赫南之间达成的交易有关。联合贸易公司在仓库中存有货物，得益于威廉·亨特的某种通融，季赫南成功从美国领事法庭获得对这些货物的“扣押令”（Attachement）；通过这一操作，债权人本会被剥夺相当可观的资产。最终，这一操作未能成功，但威廉·亨特在其中牵连甚深，足以迫使他在义务之下辞职。

最后值得注意的是——一个相当奇怪的巧合——季赫南破产案的清算人R.T. 麦克唐纳先生，目前是“威廉·亨特公司”（William Hunt）的“总经理”。/。

of William Hunt & Co. may be used as a depot for
certain activities in the Settlement or there may
be an attempt to take over the China Merchants
Steam Navigation Company, extensive enquiries
under the supervision of D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa show
that there is no evidence to confirm these alle-
gations. Details of the various firms operating
in 17 Foochow Road are attached to this report.
Many of the firms certainly have Japanese connections
but these are necessary if trade is to be conducted
in Japanese occupied areas. Observation duty has
failed to reveal visits of the Japanese Military or
the attendance of cars bearing S.D.F. licence plates.
It is quite possible that William Hunt & Co. are
anxious to be rid of tenants undesirable from other
than a political point of view.
